source_text.slice: REQ-518 slice 2c-ii (GH #2535): 404 equivalence and writes (ScopedLookup, ScopedWrites, Records scope recheck), import all-or-nothing, record attachment parent gate, resolvers, route classes (8 resolver routes, 7 explicit tenant_wide), walk rules unexpected_resolver_route and data_route_default. Tests only; nothing under lib/ or priv/ was changed; nothing committed.

task.description: Write the test spec and test code for REQ-518 slice 2c-ii (design r2a sections 1, 3.6, 5.1 to 5.7, 7.1, 10.2: T-W*, T-L*, T-D8, the mutants of 2c-ii) and the SEC code-gate (step-17) merge conditions and REVIEWER (step-18) notes. Per-file runs only under the shared mixlock; no mix letflow.check.test, no full or multi-partition suite; mutants applied in memory only.

result.summary: ROUND 2 (BUG-1 fix, SEC step-20 ruling, design r2b): extended and re-run. 155 new tests in 9 new files plus 1 support module, ALL GREEN, per file, one mix at a time under the mixlock (created and released by this step), MIX_ENV=test LOG_LEVEL=error: entities_scope_writes_http_test 32, entities_scope_attachments_http_test 13, entities_scope_production_shape_test 6, entities_scope_references_http_test 15 (new), records_scope_test 26, records_scope_references_test 14 (new), scoped_writes_test 17, route_scope_resolver_test 19, records_scope_all_scan_test 14 (the F7 pin replaced by wiring pins). Five-file Records neighbourhood green: records_test 79, entities_test 134, entities_managed_by_test 19, enforce_test 17, enforce_backstop_test 9. mix format --check-formatted: FMT=0; no compile warnings in any run; lib/ and priv/ untouched (md5 of git diff lib priv and of the new lib files identical before and after the round-2 mutant runs). NOT RUN: mix letflow.check.test, any full or multi-partition suite. Round-1 facts stand (neighbours, T-D8 re-run, 45 mutants); the four round-1 mutants whose anchors moved with the fix (MU17a, MU17c, MU39, MU39a) were re-anchored and re-measured. Dead-default check by hand: every default argument is called with and without the optional argument.

implementation_findings: BUG-1: FIXED by ELIXIR-DEV (SEC step-20 ruling, design r2b 5.3); the formerly red test is green and covered by 29 new tests. The tenant-wide nonexistent-reference 500 remains and is pinned as a pre-existing defect (issue #2832). Observation: an explicit JSON null for a reference field is the schema 422 (type) for scoped and tenant-wide callers alike, so 'null allowed' in the ruling holds for an omitted field; not an oracle (independent of any record).

OBS-1: design 5.3 / T-W23 expect POST /entities/query with a nonexistent type to differ from an undeclared existing type (error envelope vs empty page). As built both are the same empty page for a scoped caller (stricter than the design); the test pins equality.

OBS-2: MU17c is equivalent; the in-transaction new-value recheck is defence in depth, not the 'authoritative check' design 5.3 words it as. The old-value recheck is the load-bearing one and is killed by five mutants.

OBS-3: design 10.2 T-W21 lists a 403 for the attachment routes of a managed declared type; those routes have no managed lock (#2582 by design). As-built behavior pinned (served in scope, nonexistent answer out of scope); no change asked.

OBS-4: at the Records layer (module code) a NULL or non-string scope value fails type validation FIRST ({:error, {:record_payload_invalid, _}}), before the scope check; over HTTP the router's pure check runs first and the answer is the canonical 404. Refused and nothing written either way; not a defect.

OBS-5 (harness fact): a malformed JSON body raises Plug.Parsers.ParseError out of ApiPipeline when the router is called without the real endpoint error handler, so T-W3 uses parseable but invalid documents.
NO OTHER IMPLEMENTATION BUG FOUND in round 2: every test is green against the working tree and every mutant but the equivalent MU17c is killed.
